'''2007 Australian Championship Neil Kane DS Fear Is My Ally''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Neil Kane]] at [[2007 Australian Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
